items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had the pleasure of being in the rhythm section with him in Fletcher's band.

ctx.x: End of a phrase or -- ... in your arrangement --

Phrase -- he was in there all along, and how, and you could hear him because -- this was one time his size -- he was a big guy, and he drummed like that, not overshadow the band, but I mean when he hit something, or took a little solo, (inaudible), even if it was four bars, you didn't have to strain to hear him. You could hear him, you know? And he was always there. And I played with him for quite a spell. He was in that group that had Israel Crosby, so I was going handed me here, to tell you about a little thing…

Another time I had the pleasure of using Big Syd Catlett was Lena Horn on this Capital. He was playing -- you know, I should name that eight pieces the -- I can't think of a good name to describe that, the eight millionaires for those weeks, 'cause this is the money they got. In fact, --
